emerging_contaminants.disclaimer: PFAS results are public-water-system occurrence/compliance records (UCMR 5, FDEP) or nearby environmental monitoring (Water Quality Portal). They are system or watershed level, never a laboratory test of the submitted home. UCMR 5 is occurrence monitoring, not a compliance finding.

private_well_context.disclaimer: Private-well and septic records describe neighboring private infrastructure and contextual risk, not the submitted household. The 1,4-dioxane study rows are measurements of the sampled well only. Only an address-specific laboratory sample can characterize this home.

local_telemetry.disclaimer: Telemetry and watershed data are environmental-monitoring and infrastructure context maintained by Seminole County and USF. They describe watersheds, source water, and assets, not treated water at a household faucet.
